The 2026 Kings World Cup Clubs is an upcoming international seven-a-side football tournament. It is the third edition of the Kings World Cup Clubs, a competition based in the Kings League format created by Gerard Piqué and Ibai Llanos, and features the top clubs from the international versions of the Kings League. Spain's Los Troncos FC are automatically qualified as the defending world champions, having won the 2025 tournament.
Slot allocation
A revised slot allocation was announced on 5 March 2026, with the tournament scaling down from 32 clubs to 16, and not featuring any wildcard teams for the first time.
*Title holders:  Los Troncos FC
*Winners of Kings Cup Europe, Kings Cup America, and Kings Cup MENA
*Kings League Spain: 2 teams
*Kings League Italy: 2 teams
*Kings League Mexico: 2 teams
*Kings League Brazil: 2 teams
*Kings League MENA: 2 teams
*Kings League France: 1 team
*Kings League Germany: 1 team
On 27 March 2026, it was announced that Kings League MENA wouldn't run their Split 1 until October, likely due to the 2026 Iran war. The fate of the league's spots is currently unknown.
Qualified teams
Updated as of March 5, 2026. 4 clubs have qualified so far, with 12 more to be determined. Should a team qualify more than once, their excess slot(s) will be given to the next-best team(s) in their league's regular phase not already qualified.
